description: Resume a paused run after its external stage was answered (submit_stage does this for you), or a run stopped by the spend cap (pass a higher max_usd). Completed stages replay from disk and cost nothing.

allow_secret_shaped.description: continue a run the outbound key scan stopped (STOPPED-secret.md) and send the key-shaped text anyway; saved with the run from then on. Off unless given.

max_usd.description: raise the per-run ceiling for the rest of this run, a positive number. "none" removes it (refused if the user set COUNCIL_MAX_USD_LIMIT); 0 is refused.

name: resume_run
